copy.headline: Smooth start to Thanksgiving travel in DFW as gas prices continue to fall, short airport lines
copy.caption:
Thanksgiving travel is off to a smooth start across North Texas, with short security lines at local airports and falling gas prices for drivers. Crowds grew throughout the morning Wednesday at both Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport and Dallas Love Field, but security lines kept moving.

At DFW Airport, most security wait times were in the green, with a couple of checkpoints in the 11-to-20-minute range.

story.title: Smooth start to Thanksgiving travel in DFW as gas prices continue to fall, short airport lines
story.summary: Thanksgiving travel is off to a smooth start across North Texas, with short security lines at local airports and falling gas prices for drivers. DALLAS - Thanksgiving travel is off to a smooth start across North Texas, with short security lines at local airports and falling gas prices for drivers. Crowds grew throughout the morning Wednesday at both Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport and Dallas Love Field, but security lines kept moving. At DFW Airport , most security wait times were in the green, with a couple of checkpoints in the 11-to-20-minute range. At Dallas Love Field , flights were running on time Wednesday morning, with security wait times dropping from about two minutes to less than one minute. Both airports expect peak travel Wednesday and again on Nov. 29, the Sunday after Thanksgiving. Travelers should expect heavier traffic and increased activity at both airports.…
